## Description

Rooted in the Pacific Northwest and committed to crafting American Single Malt whiskey with intention, Westland has always honored the landscape that has inspired our whiskeys. Now, with the launch of our newest brand, Watchpost Whiskey, we are taking that commitment a step further with a blended whiskey that directly supports the trails that connect us to the land, donating back to Washington Trails Association.

We didn’t invent the idea of a whiskey for the great outdoors, but we spent years perfecting one that feels right at home there.

**Blend Components**

Westland Five-Malt Mashbill: Aged in New Oak & PX Casks

MGP Grain/Light Whiskey Aged in Ex-Bourbon Barrels

## Tasting notes

**Nose:** Apricot, Toasted Biscuit, Milk Chocolate, Cherry Pie

**Palate:** Lemon Squares, Vanilla, Fudge

03/25/2026

Christian Jacobsen

As a lover of whisky in all its forms, it can be hard to find one whisky I can share with friends that everyone likes. One may be too spicy or fiery. Another may be too peaty. But many times now, the bottle of Watchpost that I have brought camping, to friends' houses, and for sharing, is always enjoyed by everyone. It hits that perfect balance that gives hard-headed whisky connoisseurs satisfaction with rich flavor and complexity, while also being accessible and enjoyable to the whisky novice, too. Westland has something very special here, and I recommend it to everyone!
